module: Inspector of the Dynamic Decals tool: displays and lets you edit all properties of the selected layers (`editor.selection["dynamicDecalLayer"]`) or of the selected brush (`editor.selection["dynamicDecalBrush"]`). Common fields (uid, name, type, enabled) are drawn here; the rest is delegated to a GUI function registered per layer type via registerLayerGui (by the layerTypes/* modules).
notes: If no GUI is registered for a layer type, a text "No layerGui available for '<type>'" is displayed.
With multiple selection, each layer is in a TreeNode "uid - name".
The "Dump" button calls dump(layer); a second button dumpz(layer, 3) appears if the preference `dynamicDecalsTool.general.debug` is enabled.
The tooltip of the uid field says "Read-only type" (copy-paste).

inspectorGuiLayer.desc: Draws the inspector of the selected layers (a single one directly, several in TreeNodes). Does nothing if the selection is nil.

inspectorGuiBrush.desc: If a brush is selected, calls brushes.inspectorGui(brush).

registerLayerGui.desc: Registers the function that draws the specific properties of a layer type; it is called with (layer, guiId).

guiFn.desc: function(layer, guiId) that draws the UI.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers the float preference `dynamicDecalsTool.inspector.texturePreviewSize` (default 128, from 32 to 512).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets API, brushes, docs, widgets and helper, installs a default GUI for each layer type of api.layerTypes and registers the "Inspector" doc page.
